clean_dot_file: clean a DOT graph file by removing %tmp labeled nodes and their edges
run_DSAclean: run DSAclean on a DOT file to filter out temporary variable nodes
process_dot_graph: process a DOT graph file line by line and remove temporary node entries
filter_dot_output: filter a DOT file output to exclude nodes with %tmp labels
parse_dot_file: parse a DOT file and write cleaned output excluding temporary graph nodes
